chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Whoever prolongs his desire ruins his actions.
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of prolonging hope on a person's actions according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the psychological trap of 'long expectation' (istikbar bi-l-amal), where delaying repentance leads to spiritual stagnation. This teaching is central to Shia asceticism (zuhd), urging believers to balance hope in God's mercy with the urgency of the present moment, ensuring that deeds are performed with mindfulness rather than procrastination.
